package cache

import "testing"

func TestBehavior(t *testing.T) {
	c := &cache{cacheStorage: &storage{items: map[string]interface{}{}}}
	if err := c.Add("first"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if obj, exists, err := c.GetByKey("key"); obj != "first" || !exists || err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("changed Get: %v %v %v", obj, exists, err)
	}
	if err := c.Update("second"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if items := c.List(); len(items) != 1 || items[0] != "second" {
		t.Fatalf("changed List: %v", items)
	}
	if items, err := c.ByIndex("index", "key"); len(items) != 1 || items[0] != "second" || err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("changed ByIndex: %v %v", items, err)
	}
	if err := c.Delete("second"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if obj, exists, err := c.GetByKey("key"); obj != nil || exists || err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("changed empty Get: %v %v %v", obj, exists, err)
	}
	if err := c.Replace([]interface{}{"replacement"}, "1"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if items := c.List(); len(items) != 1 || items[0] != "replacement" {
		t.Fatalf("changed Replace: %v", items)
	}
}
